rows.label: BESS discharge duration
rows.envelope: 2 to 8 h is a common grid-storage concept envelope before duty-cycle proof.
rows.interpretation: 3.5 h implied by nameplate capacity and PCS power.
rows.evidenceRequired: Confirm use case, PCS rating, usable energy window, C-rate limits and warranty throughput.

rows.label: BESS system energy density
rows.envelope: 60 to 180 Wh/kg is a broad containerised LFP system envelope before packaging proof.
rows.interpretation: 125 Wh/kg implied by energy and gross mass.
rows.evidenceRequired: Review cell mass, racks, enclosure, HVAC, fire protection, transformer/PCS boundary and shipping mass allowance.

rows.label: BESS annual nameplate throughput
rows.envelope: Arithmetic only; real throughput depends on dispatch, degradation, auxiliary load and warranty.
rows.interpretation: 1277.5 MWh/year assumes one full equivalent cycle per day.
rows.evidenceRequired: Confirm cycles per year, usable depth of discharge, round-trip efficiency and degradation assumptions.
